answer: One concrete mechanism: force a unique proof-of-place stamp per epoch that cannot be replayed by siblings. Near-duplicate embeddings collapse the farm into one cluster. Because it works by requiring post-paid stake that is forfeited on detection, cluster rewards are paid once, not per address. The crystal of work and the kernel of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a willow to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
